## Description
A clear and concise description of the changes proposed in this Pull Request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature / Target Adapter (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🚨 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding tests or added new test coverage (`npm test`).
- [ ] All TypeScript type checks pass (`npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`).
